actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Bynder action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Bynder connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_assets_to_collection
actions.title: Add assets to collection
actions.description: Add assets to a collection in Bynder
actions.help: Specify the list of asset ids to be added to collection

input.name: id
input.label: Collection ID
input.hint: Enter the collection ID. Collection ID can be fetched from search collection action

input.name: data
input.label: Asset IDs
input.hint: Comma-separated asset ids to add to collection. Asset IDs can be fetched from the search assets action. Example "0AD55C96-9FEE-48B0-A63F189B7853A83D,0AF5180D-828A-4B3E-BE2ED0144FFECE81"

actions.name: add_tag_to_assets

input.name: id

input.hint: Enter the tag ID. Tag ID can be fetched from search tags action

input.name: data
input.label: Asset IDs

actions.name: share_collection
actions.title: Share collection
actions.help: Share collection to the list of email in Bynder

input.name: id
input.label: Collection ID
input.hint: Enter the collection id.

input.name: recipients
input.label: Recipients
input.hint: Comma-separated email addresses of recipients.

input.name: collectionOptions
input.label: Collection privacy option
input.hint: Provide view or edit option to collection

input.name: loginRequired
input.label: Login required?
input.hint: Should recipients login to view the collection. Mandatory if collectionOptions is edit.

input.name: dateStart
input.label: Start date
input.hint: Start date of the share.

input.name: dateEnd
input.label: End date
input.hint: End date of the share

input.name: sendMail
input.label: Send e-mail?
input.hint: Whether the recipients should be notified using an e-mail.

input.name: message
input.label: Message
input.hint: If send e-mail is set to true, this is an optional message to be added for the recipient(s).

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object from picklist
